Class AppointmentService

java.lang.Object
Fall2026.application.services.AppointmentService
public class AppointmentService extends Object
Service layer responsible for managing appointment booking operations.

This class provides the core business logic for creating, modifying, cancelling, and querying appointments. It integrates with the scheduling system, session management, notification service, and file persistence.

Booking rules are enforced per AppointmentType via BookingRuleStrategy, allowing each appointment type to define its own capacity limits, duration constraints, and auto-approval behaviour.

Author:
Mohannad Hamad

    • getAvailableDays

    • getSlotsForDay

      public List<Fall2026.domain.appointment.TimeSlot> getSlotsForDay(LocalDate date)
      Returns all selectable (not fully booked) time slots for the given date, without filtering by appointment type.

      US1.3: Only slots that still have capacity are returned.

      Parameters:
      date - the date to query; must not be null
      Returns:
      a list of available TimeSlot objects for that date; never null, may be empty

    • getSlotsForDay

      public List<Fall2026.domain.appointment.TimeSlot> getSlotsForDay(LocalDate date, Fall2026.domain.appointment.AppointmentType type)
      Returns selectable time slots for the given date, optionally filtered by the rules of the specified appointment type.

      US1.3: Fully booked slots are always excluded. When type is provided, slots that exceed the type's maximum duration or maximum capacity are also excluded.

      Parameters:
      date - the date to query; must not be null
      type - the appointment type whose booking rules are used to filter slots, or null to skip type-based filtering
      Returns:
      a filtered list of available TimeSlot objects; never null

    • bookAppointment

      public Fall2026.domain.appointment.Appointment bookAppointment(Fall2026.domain.appointment.TimeSlot slot, String description, int maxCapacity, Fall2026.domain.appointment.AppointmentType type)
      Books an appointment into the given time slot.

      If no appointment record exists for the slot yet, one is created and validated against the BookingRuleStrategy for the given type. The initial status is set to Appointment.AppointmentStatus.CONFIRMED if the strategy auto-approves, or Appointment.AppointmentStatus.PENDING otherwise. Each call increments the booking count by one.

      If a user session is active, a notification with the booking details and status is sent to the logged-in user.

      Parameters:
      slot - the time slot to book; must not be null
      description - a short description or reason for the appointment
      maxCapacity - the maximum number of concurrent bookings allowed for the slot
      type - the type of appointment being booked; must not be null
      Returns:
      the created or updated Appointment
      Throws:
      Fall2026.domain.exceptions.ValidationException - if the booking violates the type's rules, or if the slot is already fully booked

    • cancelAppointment

      public boolean cancelAppointment(Fall2026.domain.appointment.Appointment appointment)
      Cancels one booking from an appointment.

      Decrements the booking count by one. If the count reaches zero, the appointment record is removed from the in-memory list entirely. Changes are persisted via saveAppointments().

      Parameters:
      appointment - the appointment to cancel; must not be null
      Returns:
      true if the cancellation succeeded
      Throws:
      Fall2026.domain.exceptions.ValidationException - if the appointment's date is in the past

    • modifyAppointment

      public Fall2026.domain.appointment.Appointment modifyAppointment(Fall2026.domain.appointment.Appointment oldAppt, Fall2026.domain.appointment.TimeSlot newSlot)
      Moves an appointment to a new time slot, preserving its type and description.

      The original appointment is cancelled and a new booking is created in newSlot using the same AppointmentType, description, and max capacity as the original.

      Parameters:
      oldAppt - the appointment to move; must not be null
      newSlot - the replacement time slot; must not be null
      Returns:
      the newly created Appointment in newSlot
      Throws:
      Fall2026.domain.exceptions.ValidationException - if oldAppt is in the past, or if newSlot is full or violates booking rules

    • modifyAppointmentFull

      public Fall2026.domain.appointment.Appointment modifyAppointmentFull(Fall2026.domain.appointment.Appointment oldAppt, Fall2026.domain.appointment.TimeSlot newSlot, String newDescription)
      Moves an appointment to a new time slot and updates its description, preserving the original appointment type and max capacity.

      The original appointment is cancelled and re-booked in newSlot with newDescription. If newDescription is null, an empty string is used.

      Parameters:
      oldAppt - the appointment to modify; must not be null
      newSlot - the replacement time slot; must not be null
      newDescription - the updated description/reason; null is treated as ""
      Returns:
      the newly created Appointment in newSlot
      Throws:
      Fall2026.domain.exceptions.ValidationException - if oldAppt is in the past, or if newSlot is full or violates booking rules

    • removeSlot

      public void removeSlot(Fall2026.domain.appointment.TimeSlot slot)
      Removes a time slot from the schedule and cancels any appointment booked into it.

      If an appointment exists for the given slot it is removed from the in-memory list directly, bypassing normal cancellation validation (e.g. past-date checks do not apply here).

      Parameters:
      slot - the time slot to remove; must not be null

      Sets the file manager used to persist and load appointments.
